title: Terminal agent marks (experiments.terminalAgentMark): Claude Code and Codex in terminal tabs beside a Claude agent chat; the switch flips live, off (default, every agent's bare mark) to on (terminal agents' marks on a soft rounded square) and back

claude.description: A stand-in Claude agent chat that answers each prompt once (Terminal agent marks tour)

steps.title: Claude Code reports from the first terminal tab
cmux: clear; cmux agent hook emit --source claude --event SessionStart --payload-json '{"session_id":"7e2a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"}' && echo HOOK-SENT

steps.title: Codex reports from it
cmux: clear; cmux agent hook emit --source codex --event SessionStart --payload-json '{"session_id":"7e2a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"}' && echo HOOK-SENT

steps.title: A Claude agent chat tab beside them
steps.optional: the capture Mac's acpmux daemon was not up (chat.create_failed, no socket, 2026-11-25); the marks still show on the terminal tabs

steps.title: Off (the default): terminal agents and the chat all draw the bare mark
Flip Settings > Experiments > Terminal Agent Marks on, live
On: Claude Code's and Codex's terminal tabs wear their mark on a rounded square; the chat keeps the bare mark
